fact: The article says the government of Guinea is working with the startup FindMe to pilot digital addressing solutions, particularly to upgrade postal services.

Urbanism minister Mory Condé said on 3 October 2024 that a national addressing programme is 100% done in Kaloum commune and will extend to Dixinn, Matam, the other Conakry communes, Coyah, Dubréka and regional and prefecture towns.
